input.relationship: src/checkout.ts#checkout call src/cart.ts#Cart.total (forward); src/cart.ts#Cart.total call src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount (forward)

evidence.reason: Agent changed return from formatMoney(cart.total()) to "Total: " + formatMoney(cart.total()), altering the output contract relied on by test/shop.test.mjs:9 which expects "USD 18.00".
Human added a required third parameter currency: string, making existing two-argument calls incompatible.
Caller invokes applyDiscount(amount, 0.1) with two arguments; after the signature change this call is missing the required currency argument.
Caller invokes applyDiscount(price, 0.1) with two arguments, now missing the required currency argument.
Caller invokes applyDiscount(price, 0.2) with two arguments, now missing the required currency argument.
Re-exported alias of applyDiscount now has a changed signature, affecting external consumers.
Test asserts applyDiscount(100, 0.1) === 90, which no longer matches the required three-argument signature.
Test asserts checkout(cart) === "USD 18.00", which conflicts with the agent's "Total: " prefix.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动合并后会同时破坏结账输出格式和折扣函数的调用签名，现有测试和调用方都会失败，需要先确认货币参数是否真的必要以及结账前缀是否符合预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/pricing.ts#applyDiscount 的修改者确认 currency 参数是否必需；若必需，应同步更新 src/cart.ts#Cart.total、src/pricing.ts#PriceRule.apply、src/pricing.ts#SeasonalRule.apply 及测试中的调用，并让 src/checkout.ts#checkout 的修改者确认 "Total: " 前缀是否应保留或改为由 formatMoney 处理。
